notes.title: Delay...
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

I want to apologize for this unfortunate delay.. The game is gold and can be completed. However, during testing and seeing player feedback, the game itself is a bit too difficult. I'm a solo developer for this project. I won't be back home for 2 months so please bare with me! I know where the issues are, they're easily fixable so once I get back, I'll be sure to get those done on day 1 and get this game out ASAP! I want to make the best experience possible for you, the player. With that being said, I will continue to make updates when I can. 

Thank y'all very much and I'll be sure to have this out very very soon!

Best, 
Arturo

notes.title: Official release THIS WEEK!
notes.notes: We are here! sorry for the delays! I've been busy with some personal matters in life. The game is officially done though! Rita is officially GOLD! Just testing final bugs and heavily testing for issues in regard to small cosmetic bugs. I will try and release the game officially this week! Stay tuned!!!

notes.title: Closer to Release!
notes.notes:
Hello all!

This update comes with the following:
[list]
[*] Prefab layering fixes
[*] Text fixes
[*] Light tinkering
[*] Path leading tinkering. 
[*] Added controller input UI 
[/list]

As mentioned above, the game is fully playable. However, I'm still trying to figure out how to implement the controller UI to appear over the regular keyboard txt UI, whenever a controller is connected/ disconnected. 

Thank you!
